name: Timeero
summary: Timeero records trips automatically for employees on the clock, applies built-in IRS rate calculations and exports detailed mileage reports to payroll tools. Its pricing page lists Basic at $5 a user a month on annual billing, Pro at $7.50 and Premium at $10, with Enterprise by contact sales.

facts.text: The Timeero home page says trips are captured automatically while employees are on the clock, and that each stop's timestamp and full route are recorded.
The Timeero home page says built-in IRS rate calculations make reimbursement fast and accurate. The page does not mention custom rates.
The mileage page says Timeero provides detailed mileage reports that can be exported to payroll software to automate reimbursement calculations.
Timeero's pricing page says Enterprise pricing is available by contacting sales.
